notice_markdown:
## ONNX attribution supplement

ONNX 1.22.0 retains its Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE under THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/onnx. Its upstream NOTICE labels the vendored protobuf 25.1 component Apache-2.0 while the ONNX upstream SBOM labels it BSD-3-Clause; the protobuf v25.1 license text is retained as THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/onnx/3-protobuf-v25.1-LICENSE.txt and the verified provenance as THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES/onnx/ATTRIBUTION.json beside the upstream SBOM copy. Upstream files are unchanged; this is attribution, not legal approval.
